title: TÄRNKULLEN upholstered bed frame
description: TÄRNKULLEN upholstered bed frame, Vissle beige, Queen This bed frame has a soft cover with a loose fit, a hanging skirt and carefully sewn details. The cover can be removed and machine washed – so that the bed stays fresh year after year.
features: Slatted bed base and mattress sold separately.
Combine this bed frame with a slatted bed base with a max. thickness of 1⅝" to keep the slats hidden in the frame. The slats of a higher bed base may be visible along the sides of the bed.
materialAndCare: Fabric: 100% polyester (min. 90% recycled); Filling: 100% polyester (min. 70% recycled); Lining, underside: 100 % polypropylene; Smolder resistant lining: Polyester wadding; Midbeam: Laminated veneer lumber; Top frame/ Bottom frame/ Footboard/ Bedside: Solid wood, Laminated veneer lumber, Fiberboard; Filling: Polyurethane foam 2.0 lb/cu.ft., Polyester wadding; Leg: Solid wood, Oak veneer, Clear acrylic lacquer; Hook and loop fastener: Polyamide; Cross-brace: Steel, Galvanized
